script_error.title: Script Error
script_error.message:
The script file contains errors and the game cannot be started.
Please check the script file and restart.
crash.title: Looks like a problem occurred
crash.warning: In the event of a catastrophic error, clicking Continue may still exit the game.
error.reason.script_compile: Script compilation failed due to lexical, syntax, or type-check errors. Please check the script file.
error.reason.script_runtime: A runtime error occurred while executing the script (the VM threw an exception).
error.reason.script_resource: A resource referenced by the script (background/character/music/voice) is missing. Please provide the missing files.
error.reason.save_load: Failed to load the save file; it may be corrupted or incompatible with the current version.
error.reason.render: The renderer encountered an anomaly (resource loading or drawing failed).
error.reason.settings: Failed to parse the settings file; the configuration may be corrupted.
error.reason.fatal: An unknown fatal error occurred. Please export the log and restart the engine.
gpu.software_renderer: Software rendering detected ({renderer}). Performance and visual correctness may be compromised; a hardware OpenGL 3.3+ GPU is recommended.
gpu.llvmpipe: LLVMpipe software renderer detected. This is known to cause rendering glitches (e.g. overlapping sprites). Please use a hardware GPU.
gpu.vmware: VMware virtual GPU detected ({renderer}). Virtual GPUs may not correctly support all OpenGL features, which can cause visual artifacts.
gpu.old_opengl: OpenGL version too old ({version}). Version 3.3+ is recommended; older versions may cause rendering issues.
gpu.unknown_renderer: Unable to identify GPU renderer. If you experience visual glitches, please update your graphics driver.
